HIGH RIVER FLOW (30 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
This task looks at estimating the probability of high river flows.
Planners need to estimate the probability of extreme events such as high river flow.
To do this they use the return period, R years.
This is an estimate of the number of years before they expect another high river flow.
